column_description: Primary key (VARCHAR(30)) uniquely identifying a vendor (e.g., 'VEND-Abc123').
An INT indicating how many days the vendor has been active (e.g., 120).
A NUMERIC(4,2) (0–99.99) rating for the vendor based on reviews (e.g., 92.75).
An INT total number of completed transactions for the vendor (e.g., 3500).
An INT number of undisputed or successful transactions (e.g., 3400).
An INT number of disputed transactions (e.g., 100).
A SMALLINT representing how many listings the vendor has created (e.g., 45).
A SMALLINT showing how many payment methods the vendor accepts (e.g., 3).
An enum (VendCheckLvl_enum) describing the vendor’s verification tier (Basic, Advanced, Premium).
A DATE recording the vendor's last activity (e.g., '2025-03-15').
FK referencing Markets(MktRegistry) linking this vendor to a specific market.
